description: Sets the voltage on each channel of a polyphonic cable by hand, with optional quantising to semitones

params.text: Sets how many channels the output carries, 1 to 16; channels above that are sent 0V
Sets the voltage on that channel of the output, -10V to 10V

outputs.text: The polyphonic cable carrying the voltage set for each channel

menu: Quantise — Quantised rounds every channel voltage to the nearest semitone on a 1V/octave scale, Unquantised passes it as the knob sets it
